hook: Osmania Hospital junior doctors strike again, *2 weeks* after truce
tldr: OGH junior doctors resumed their strike on Oct 27 over pending Arogyasri funds and late stipends.

beats.what: Junior doctors at Osmania General Hospital resumed their strike on Tuesday, Oct 27.
beats.why: They say pending Arogyasri money has left wards short of medicines, consumables and working equipment.
beats.care: Heading to OGH for heart, kidney or scan work? Call ahead and keep a backup hospital in mind.

cards.body: The Junior Doctors Association (JUDA) at OGH, Afzalgunj, is back on strike. Their first strike began Oct 12 and ended Oct 13 after health officials gave assurances. They say nothing moved. Their letter went to Health Minister C Damodar Rajanarasimha. Demands: release Arogyasri funds, fix facilities, pay PG and super-speciality stipends on time, and revise stipends regularly. They say the Cath Lab, CTVS (heart and chest surgery) and CRRT (dialysis for very sick patients) are not working. No government response has been reported yet.

cards.q: Have you or family used a govt hospital this year?
What are OGH junior doctors mainly protesting?
opts: Pending Arogyasri funds and late stipends
cards.why: Pending Arogyasri funds hit supplies; stipends are paid late.

learn.t: Arogyasri: Telangana's state health scheme that pays hospitals for treating eligible families for free. When its money is late, government hospitals run short of supplies.

watch: Whether the Health Minister meets JUDA or releases funds; no talks reported yet.
